content.text: The whole chain was denied; I'll write the file directly.

I added `scripts/export_invoices.py`, ran it to produce `out/invoices.csv` (12 rows), and committed both as `9676540`.

**One difference from the customers export:** `export_customers.py` also drops rows where `seg` is `"C"`. `tables/invoices.csv` has no `seg` column (`invoice_id,customer_id,issued,amount`), so the invoices script copies every row. If invoices need the same exclusion, it would mean looking up each customer's `seg`. Tell me if you want that.

**Line endings:** the output has the same rows and values as `tables/invoices.csv`, but `diff` reports every line as changed. That's because Python's CSV writer ends lines with CRLF; the customers export uses the same writer, so the two outputs match each other.

**Commit message:** it doesn't start with a month, because no data file changed. I followed the style of the last script commit ("export_customers: filter on seg").

January is still uncommitted, as you said: `inbox/2026-01.csv` hasn't been copied into `data/`.
